name: an empty span at the end of input after a line feed
an empty span at the end of a line marks one column
a span across lines
a span that starts at the end of its line and goes on
tabs and a carriage return are spaces in the excerpt
a control character is a space in the excerpt
U+0085 is a space in the excerpt, U+2028 is itself
a byte order mark is not in the excerpt
wide and combining characters are one column each
the excerpt is the line of the start of the span
a line of exactly 120 columns is written whole
a line of 121 columns: the window start is lowered to n - 119
a long line with the span at its start
a long line with the span at its end
a long line with the span in its middle, cut at both sides
a span longer than the window
no source: no excerpt, the trace is still written
